description: A new Starlight-based RGB/SCALAR lighting engine for Cleanroom.

releases.notes:
### Added

- Filter RGB light through all 16 colors of Chisel stained glass and panes,
  and all 16 Xtones Glaxx variants.

### Changed

- Spread the initial RGB lighting sync across server ticks when a player joins.
- Reduce server tick time in builds with many ArchitectureCraft: Renovated shapes
  by refreshing their cached light opacity when it changes. This includes version 0.9.1.
- Reduce redundant checks for position-dependent light values during bulk block placement.

### Fixed

- Use the base material's emission color for glowing ArchitectureCraft: Renovated
  0.9.1 shapes held in either hand or dropped as items, matching their placed appearance.
- Report lighting worker failures to callers waiting for a batch, including failures
  that occur while creating its lighting engine.

### Fixed

- Reduce frame stalls and direct-buffer exhaustion when rebuilding detailed terrain
  such as dense ArchitectureCraft shapes in the vanilla renderer.
- Fix a conflict with Expanded World Height when sending multi-block updates.

### Changed

- Support zero-based worlds with an extended height reported by `World.getHeight()`.
- Reduce allocations when retrying deferred chunk sends and skip unnecessary light
  reads during initial RGB block-light scans.

### Fixed

- Fix a startup crash when Celeritas replaces the vanilla terrain renderer.
  Verified with Celeritas 2.5.0-dev and 2.6.0-dev ([#32](https://github.com/Sumire-Labs/Pulsar/issues/32)).

### Changed

- Reduce temporary allocations during Forge and Celeritas lighting calculations.
  RGB terrain rendering now reuses nearby chunk lighting data while building each mesh.
- Reduce Dynamic Lights memory use by sharing identical occlusion data across color
  channels and avoiding redundant copies when building and transferring light data.
- Reduce memory use when loading saved RGB lighting by sharing identical light arrays
  until a channel changes. Speed up detection of all-zero light arrays when saving chunks.
- Speed up initial block lighting with Fluidlogged API 3.3.3 by skipping sections
  whose block palette and stored fluid data rule out light sources.

### Added

- Add Dynamic Lights settings for movement update frequency, player and entity sources,
  light from blocks carried by pistons, water-sensitive items, and primed TNT and creeper flashes.

### Changed

- Reduce stuttering when walking with a light source by scheduling light-only updates to
  existing vanilla terrain meshes on the background chunk dispatcher.
- Reduce repeated light sampling during terrain rendering and limit RGB terrain updates
  to the area affected by changed light values.

### Fixed

- Apply handheld light to Fancier and Fanciest Block Particles in visual-only mode.

### Changed

- Default Dynamic Lights to `GAMEPLAY` in new configurations, so moving light sources
  affect server light checks such as mob spawning. Existing mode settings are preserved.

### Added

- Add experimental Dynamic Lights for both SCALAR and RGB. Held and dropped light sources, such as
  torches and lava buckets, illuminate their surroundings, as do burning mobs and players.
  In RGB mode, stained glass filters the color of that light.
- Dynamic Lights default to `VISUAL` for a purely visual effect like Celeritas Dynamic Lights.
  Set `dynamicLights.mode` in the server config to `GAMEPLAY` to include dynamic light
  in checks such as mob spawning, or `OFF` to disable it. Restart to apply the setting.
  Both enabled modes require compatible Pulsar clients.

### Fixed

- Smooth the color transitions between nearby RGB light sources when using shader packs.
  This fixes sharp bands across flat surfaces seen with Demonica 0.9.0 and Complementary Reimagined.

### Added

- Expand RGB presets across 20 mods to cover more crystals, luminous plants,
  candles, lanterns, working machines and glowing fluids, including sources from
  Actually Additions, Botania, Thaumcraft, Quark and Thermal Foundation.
  Presets preserve native light levels, contextual on/off behavior and custom color APIs.

### Fixed

- Register Thaumic Augmentation's Ancient Light using the actual stone block
  state, and add its glowing crusted stone variant.
- Apply Quark crystal-pane colors to the nine separately registered pane blocks.
- Prevent failed lighting tasks and exhausted retries from marking chunks ready
  or allowing incomplete light to be sent or saved as a valid cache.
- Stop RGB edge retries at their configured limit and report failed relights to
  waiting callers. Failures from older relight requests no longer affect newer ones.
- Publish RGB color data before announcing completed lighting in VANILLA gameplay
  light mode.

### Added

- Add industrial RGB presets for Mekanism's glowing plastic, refined blocks,
  energized smelters, superheating elements and heat/gas/bio generators.
- Sample Mekanism Glow Panel dye colors and GTCEu cable temperature on the
  world thread, including color changes without block-state changes.
- Add all 32 GTCEu normal/borderless lamp presets, preserving power, inversion,
  bloom and light-emission settings.
- Add Ender IO electric lights, light nodes, Cold Fire, painted glowstone,
  Liquid Sunshine and dye-specific enlightened glass/quartz presets.
- Add Actually Additions colored lamps, tiny torches and double-furnace presets.
  All presets retain native brightness and existing API/user overrides.

### Changed

- Update DevEnv.

### Removed

- Remove Actinium-specific renderer integration. Actinium targets Cleanroom 0.6.x;
  Pulsar requires Cleanroom 0.7.14-alpha or newer within the 0.7.x series.

### Fixed

- Respect closed outgoing block faces during SCALAR and RGB light recalculation,
  avoiding false mismatches and unnecessary relighting at chunk boundaries near
  slabs and other sided blocks.
- Release completed tasks and their chunk references from stale priority indexes
  when a lighting queue drains.
- Clear partially initialized engine caches after setup failures, so reused
  engines do not retain stale chunk data.
- Reject invalid saved light-nibble states on load, allowing corrupt caches to
  relight before they can cause errors on later saves.

### Changed

- Update DevEnv.

### Fixed

- Block light crossing the sealed horizontal boundary between adjacent upper
  and lower opaque slabs in SCALAR and RGB lighting (issue #29).
- Avoid dark bands on exposed wall faces next to slabs by sampling their visible
  cavity instead of the opaque wall's interior at covered vertices (issue #29).
- Rebuild older saved lighting with cache version 15 to remove leaked slab light.

### Added

- Add RGB source-color presets identified through ColoredLux's 1.12.2 Lux Packs:
  Quark candles, crystals and lanterns; Inspirations lights; Embers and Embers Construct;
  Immersive Engineering lanterns and balloons; Charm lamps; NetherEx and TAIGA sources;
  Deep Mob Learning; HarvestCraft candles; Coloured Sea Lanterns; Advanced Chimneys;
  Exotic Birds; Tinker I/O; and Tinkers' Construct's glowing block.
- Add an end-portal-colored preset for end gateways. All new presets retain the
  original contextual brightness and lit/unlit behavior, without creating new light sources.

### Changed

- Update DevEnv.
- Require Java 25 and Cleanroom Loader 0.7.14-alpha or newer within the 0.7.x series.

### Fixed

- Preserve the runtime name of Forge's five-argument `BufferBuilder.putColorRGBA`
  method when building production Mixins.
- Use the LWJGL texture-environment query supported by the new Cleanroom environment.

## [0.6.2]

### Added

- Add RGB lighting for Fancier Block Particles and Fanciest Block Particles,
  including their custom batched particle renderers.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Sumire-Labs/Pulsar/compare/0.6.1...0.6.2

## [0.6.1] - 2026-10-31

### Added

- Add RGB source-color presets for end rods and magma blocks.
- Add Future MC lantern, soul lantern and campfire colors, preserving their
  original light levels and lit/unlit behavior.
- Add source-color presets for Thermal Foundation, Thermal Expansion,
  BuildCraft, Railcraft, Forestry, BiblioCraft, OpenComputers and Galacticraft.
- Add a glowstone-colored preset for Extra Utilities 2's glowing glass variant.
  Other decorative glass variants retain their existing behavior.

### Changed

- Align vanilla and supported mod source hues with SuperNova, including
  glowstone, jack o'lanterns, portals, lanterns and Botania's blaze block.
  Preserve contextual brightness, mod-provided color APIs and user overrides.
- Match SuperNova's dim dye palette rounding for Botania buried petals and
  mushrooms without changing their contextual light levels.
- Soften dim RGB hues while retaining absorbed color channels at zero.
  Genuine skylight and other light sources can still mix with filtered light.

### Fixed

- Prevent Celeritas from borrowing sky or block light through closed stair and slab faces,
  fixing light leaks around carpets and flowers underneath them (#20).
- Prevent non-legacy RGB tinting from adding white components back to light
  filtered through colored glass. Apply the same correction to the generic
  shader lightmap bridge.
- Correct the OkLab forward transform to match its inverse, preventing hue
  shifts in isolated primary colors.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Sumire-Labs/Pulsar/compare/0.6.0...0.6.1

## [0.6.0] - 2026-10-30 - The Dawn of a World in Color

### Added

- Add optional RGB block and sky lighting for terrain, fluids, entities,
  particles, held items and tile entities in Vanilla/Forge and Celeritas.
- Add a one-time SCALAR/RGB selection screen with English and Japanese text.
  Save the choice per instance and request a restart when changing the active mode.
- Add RGB_MAX gameplay brightness and an independent VANILLA lighting policy.
  Compatible SCALAR clients can receive authoritative gameplay light from RGB servers.
- Add additive, squared-weight, linear-weight, OkLab, vivid and MAXIMUM RGB blends.
  MAXIMUM preserves neutral full daylight; LEGACY retains the earlier appearance.
- Add source-color presets for Botania, Twilight Forest, Thaumcraft 6,
  Tinkers' Construct, Biomes O' Plenty, Natura, Natura Legacy, Chisel,
  Applied Energistics 2 and Ars Magica 2: Rekindled.
- Add CBMultipart lighting integration and RGB support for ProjectRed lamps,
  fixtures, buttons and light microblocks, preserving brightness and power state.
- Add configurable source colors and per-channel filters in `pulsar-colors.cfg`
  and `pulsar-filters.cfg`. `/pulsar reload` validates changes, rolls back failures
  and relights loaded chunks automatically.
- Add optional RGB shader lighting, tested with Demonica and Complementary Reimagined.
- Add public static/positional lighting APIs, a Forge registration event,
  API/source artifacts and conversion helpers for SuperNova light values.
- Add opt-in lighting/render tracing and Celeritas rebuild diagnostics.

### Changed

- Default to SCALAR. RGB uses squared-weight blending and RGB_MAX gameplay light
  by default; existing explicit mode choices are preserved.
- Upgrade the config schema to version 3, preserving existing settings and filling
  missing options with current defaults.
- Reduce lighting memory use and allocation through shared immutable data,
  lazy buffers and worker reuse.
- Reduce redundant skylight work during chunk generation and updates.
- Batch contextual light notifications and avoid unnecessary polling of constant
  Multipart light sources.
- Align vanilla source hues and stained-glass/pane filtering with SuperNova's
  lighting palette while retaining contextual brightness and explicit overrides.
- Deprecate the legacy no-op light flush API and clarify lighting readiness queries.
- Require compatible Pulsar clients for RGB_MAX servers. SCALAR servers retain
  ordinary client compatibility.

### Fixed

- Save light-only changes on otherwise untouched chunks, including neighbouring chunks.
- Keep lighting usable when mod callbacks fail, retaining previous/static samples
  without blocking chunk visibility or saving degraded light as a valid cache.
- Prevent stale light caches and missed dynamic-source updates around palette reloads
  and cached chunk loading.
- Correct night-time sky attenuation, mixed-hue brightness and signed lightmap
  coordinate handling in RGB rendering.
- Center manual relights correctly at negative fractional coordinates.
- Avoid the OptiFine G5 startup crash (#26). Full OptiFine rendering/RGB compatibility
  remains unsupported.
- Prevent premature lighting-completion reports and missing chunk updates after
  large edits or during initial chunk loading.
- Fix intermittent login packet encoding errors and RGB disconnection handling.

## What's Changed
* RGB Lighting Mode by @pepelys in https://github.com/Sumire-Labs/Pulsar/pull/23
* feat: add public API by @pepelys in https://github.com/Sumire-Labs/Pulsar/pull/27
* fix: avoid OptiFine startup crash by @pepelys in https://github.com/Sumire-Labs/Pulsar/pull/28


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Sumire-Labs/Pulsar/compare/0.5.3...0.6.0

### Fixed

- Prevent skylight from brightening wall faces partly hidden by adjacent stairs
  or slabs (issue #20).
- Sample the exposed surfaces of slab and stair models, including inset treads
  and risers, in Vanilla, Forge and Celeritas lighting paths (issue #20).
- Exclude hidden edge and diagonal light from smooth-lighting corners, including
  slab halves and stair shapes, in Vanilla, Forge and Celeritas (MC-12558,
  issue #20).
- Prevent light leaks through carpets below stairs (issue #20).
- Fix the chunk-packet redirect conflict with SpongeForge's asynchronous
  lighting by preserving its captured section arrays (issue #24).

### Changed

- Reduce redundant TileEntity light sampling and spread background checks
  across ticks with configurable sample and time budgets. Explicit lighting
  update requests remain prioritized (issue #24).
- Improve parallel lighting concurrency by allowing read-only chunk halos
  to overlap while preserving exclusion around writes.

### **Full Changelog**: 
https://github.com/Sumire-Labs/Pulsar/compare/0.5.2...0.5.3

## [0.5.2]

### Fixed

- Prevent initial chunk packets from waiting indefinitely with Fluidlogged API.
  Skip vanilla's redundant random player lighting repair request, which otherwise
  creates new pending samples before every send attempt. Block/fluid updates and
  the contextual-light gate used by Thaumcraft crystals remain active.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Sumire-Labs/Pulsar/compare/0.5.1...0.5.2
